thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: SEV2 - elevated 5xx (502/504) errors observed at Edge gateway (us-west-2). Spike started ~10:12 UTC. Paging on-call.

amanda: ack, I'm on it. seeing spike in the dashboard: 5xx rate ~11-13% for API gateway /v1/generate. latency p95 up to 2.8s. traffic looks normal. linking dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/d/srv-edge

luke: digging into edge logs now. quick grep shows a lot of these:
```
[2026-03-14T10:13:02Z] upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client=1.2.3.4, server=edge-01
[2026-03-14T10:13:03Z] 502 while reading response from upstream
```
looks like origin pool `model-router` returning slow or not responding.

amanda: was there any deploy around 10:00? I don't see infra deploys in the window, but there was a feature flag flip for abtest/fastpath at 09:58 by maya.

maya: I toggled abtest/fastpath -> enabled for 10% traffic (aiming to short-circuit some requests). I can revert immediately if that's suspected.

luke: try reverting the flag first, if it's routing to an unscaled backend.

sanjay: I agree rollback AB test as quick mitigation. also increasing proxy timeout gives immediate relief if backends are just slower.

emma: quick customer impact summary: failed requests concentrated on Generate endpoint, about 8k failed reqs over last 10m, ~200 affected API keys (top 5 account ids: acct-112, acct-223, acct-998, acct-501, acct-777). Notifying SRE pager for accounts with SLA.

amanda: mitigation plan
- 10:18 revert abtest/fastpath -> off (maya)
- 10:19 increase nginx upstream timeout on edge from 5s -> 10s (luke)
- 10:21 temporarily scale up `model-router` replicas + add emergency burst pool (sanjay)
- 10:25 enable fallback route at gateway to `model-v1-fallback` for backend 5xx (emma)

maya: rolling abtest rollback now.

luke: patching edge config to extend timeout. running:
```
# on edge-config
kubectl -n edge set env ds/nginx EDGE_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT=10
kubectl -n edge rollout restart ds/nginx
```

amanda: watch logs and error rate. if rollback helps, we'll keep studying root cause.

(2 minutes later)

luke: after abtest rollback error rate dropped from 12% -> 6% in 90s. after nginx timeout bump it's down to 3.2%. p95 latency improving.

sanjay: scaling model-router: `kubectl scale deployment model-router --replicas=12 -n serving` — replicas up, starting new pods.

emma: enabling gateway-level fallback policy for /v1/generate for 5xx to route to `model-v1-fallback`:
```
PATCH /gateway/policies
{"match": "/v1/generate", "on_5xx": "route: model-v1-fallback"}
```

amanda: good. start customer comms draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates on inference API. Mitigations applied; partial restoration in progress. Will update in 30m or on resolution." (sending to #customer-notify).

maya: redeploy abtest config reverted successfully. logs show no error spikes from the abtest path anymore.

luke: model-router pods show a few OOMKill events earlier around 10:05; looks like they were getting saturated by short-circuit traffic. kube events attached:
```
Warning  OOMKilled  20s (x3 over 30s)  kubelet  container model-router killed due to memory
```

sanjay: root cause hypothesis: abtest/fastpath routed some traffic to an insufficiently provisioned model-router variant which exhausted memory and caused connection timeouts; edge timed out to upstream causing 502/504.

amanda: agree. next steps
- repro on staging with abtest config and load generator (eng-ml)
- increase memory requests/limits for model-router or add autoscaling based on queue depth
- add circuit breaker at edge to failover faster to fallback model
- postmortem if confirmed cause

eng-oncall: I'm taking the on-call handoff for the next 2h to monitor regressions. will coordinate with eng-ml for root cause testing. please add me to incident channel.

emma: count baseline: total requests last 30m 120k, failures peaked at ~14k/min at spike. current 5xx rate ~0.9% now. marking impact as partial degraded service to some customers. escalation to SE team for top impacted accounts started.

luke: continuing to tail logs, no new OOMs after scale-up. memory usage per pod steady ~65%. keeping autoscaler warm.

maya: adding a temporary limit on percentage of traffic for abtest/fastpath to 1% globally until we validate variant performance.

sanjay: will prepare a quick config change to set circuit-breaker thresholds:
```
circuit_breaker:
  max_concurrent: 200
  max_retries: 2
  backoff_ms: 200
```

amanda: thanks team. updating incident board with mitigations and timeline. next update 10:45 UTC or earlier if something changes. handing off monitoring to @eng-oncall — please escalate if errors >2% for >5m.

eng-oncall: ack, monitoring. I'll keep this channel open and post any regressions. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> "mitigated" (partial): 5xx rates reduced, workload scaled. Incident owner: amanda. Postmortem required.

amanda: noted. saving logs & metrics snapshot, open postmortem ticket and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml for RCA. Closing thread for active mitigation; will reopen if spike returns. :white_check_mark:
